correctness.rationale: Eigenvalues of the unweighted P3 path Laplacian are 0,1,3; endpoint propagator amplitude a(s)=1/3-(1/2)cos(s)+(1/6)cos(sqrt(3)s), s=τsqrt(k/M). Because a lies in [-1/3,1], nearly unit fidelity entails s within O(1/s) of odd πq and sqrt(3)s near even πp. Taylor expansion yields infidelity e1²/2+e2²/6+O(s^-4). Completion into ((e2-sqrt(3)e1)²+(sqrt(3)e1+e2)²)/12, and the nonzero integer Pell norm p²-3q², give the uniform over-all-times lower bound π⁴/144 after scaling. Odd powers (2+sqrt(3))^(2j+1), p even q odd, norm +1, give phases with exact errors π/(2sqrt(3)z), -π/(2z) at s=πz/(2sqrt(3)), saturating the sharp constant. No uniform-in-τ claim is made for original small-ε discrete walk.
